cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ref, main as impl, fuzz

# 1. overlapping / self-overlapping patterns (KMP border torture)
pats = [
    ('a',), ('a','a'), ('a','a','a','a'), ('a','b','a','b'), ('a','b','a','a','b'),
    ('b','a','a','b','a'), ('a','a','b','a','a'), ('a','b','b','a','b','a'),
    ('a','a','b','b','a','a','b'), ('b','b','b','a','b','b','b'),
]
services = ['a','b']
count = 0
fails = 0
for op in ('match','startswith','endswith','contains'):
    for p in pats:
        for extra in (None, {'op':'not','arg':{'op':op,'path':list(p)}},
                     {'op':'and','args':[{'op':op,'path':list(p)},{'op':'contains','path':[]}]},
                     {'op':'or','args':[{'op':op,'path':list(p)},{'op':'false'}]}):
            when = extra if extra else {'op':op,'path':list(p)}
            for acts in (('allow',),('drop',),('allow','allow')):
                rules = [{'action':a,'when':when} for a in acts]
                queries = [[],['a'],['a','a'],['a','b'],['b','a','b'],['a','b','a','b','a'],
                           ['a','a','b','a','a','b'],['a','b','b','a','b','a','b','b'],
                           list(p) if p else [], (list(p)+['a']) if p else ['a']]
                req = {'services':services,'rules':rules,'queries':queries}
                got = json.loads(impl.process(json.dumps(req).encode()))
                exp = ref.compile_reference(req)
                ok = (got == exp)
                count += 1
                if not ok:
                    fails += 1
                    print('MISMATCH', op, p, rules[0]['action'], json.dumps(when))
                    print(' got', json.dumps(got))
                    print(' exp', json.dumps(exp))
                    break
                fuzz.check_dfa(req, got)
print('border torture: %d cases, %d failures' % (count, fails))

# 2. canonical determinism under rule permutation
rng = random.Random(77)
for trial in range(60):
    req = fuzz.gen_medium(rng)
    base = impl.process(json.dumps(req).encode())
    same = True
    for _ in range(3):
        rules = req['rules'][:]
        rng.shuffle(rules)
        req2 = {'services':req['services'],'rules':rules,'queries':req['queries']}
        out = impl.process(json.dumps(req2).encode())
        if out != base:
            same = False
            print('PERMUTATION DIFFERENCE')
            print(json.dumps(req))
            print(base[:200])
            print(out[:200])
            break
    if not same:
        break
print('rule permutation invariance checked')
EOF
